messages:
maria: follow-up from PM 4/12 ETL lag created delayed spans and incorrect aggregations. need owners, ETAs, and verification.

ajay: I'll own detection + dashboarding. adding rolling ETL latency and missing_span counter. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

dave: I'll take the pipeline fix. root cause = windowing regression after reorder change. plan: revert in staging, add ordering test, run targeted backfill for 04/12-04/14. ETA: Wed COB.

sasha: Alerts & CI gating here. adding prom alert median_etl_ms > 120s (5m) + synthetic post-deploy span check. gate integration test in CI. ETA: Tue AM.

obs-bot: Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pms/ETL-2026-04-12 43 span-drop spike.

maria: please add PR links and a short runbook entry for oncall triage. flag possible recurring pattern ~6-8w after ordering-touching deploys.

ajay: Dashboard PR: https://git.redwood/infra/mon/pulls/449. SQL snippet added to PR.

dave: Backfill PR/job: https://git.redwood/etl/pulls/412, backfill job bf-20260415-2. Revert commit: a1b2c3.

sasha: CI PR: https://git.redwood/ci/pulls/101 4 adds synthetic run + postdeploy reconciliation. Runbook snippet: "on span-drop spike -> pause deploys, run backfill job, notify #incidents & oncall."

maria: recap owners: Ajay (detection) EOD tomorrow; Dave (pipeline+backfill) Wed COB; Sasha (alerts+CI) Tue AM. Scheduling a 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 to check progress.

ajay: also prototyping a low-noise detector to cut false positives.

maria: thanks all. we close when dashboards merged, backfill done, CI gating live, and runbook posted. I'll sign off here. :white_check_mark:
